decisions.reason: Only mentioned on the website, indicating limited public commitment and likely lower sunk investment, so disappointing results are harder to justify and the product is more likely to be dropped.
Presented on its own page, signaling visible commitment and higher investment, so management is likely to persist with it despite any early disappointments.
Merely mentioned on the website with little public commitment, so little is lost and nothing has to be justified if the product is discontinued.
Only a brief website mention suggests low investment and no visible commitment, making it easier to drop when results falter.
Having its own page indicates strong public commitment and substantial investment, so management will likely continue it to justify those sunk costs.
A dedicated page reflects visible commitment and higher investment, so escalation of commitment favors keeping the product on the market.
